service_at_issue: Home health services furnished to one beneficiary (B.K.), Oct 2004 - Aug 2005
facts: (Dates of service from October 5, 2004, through June 1, 2005; and from August 1, 2005, though September 29, 2005)

Beneficiary B.K. started care with the home health agency on June 15, 2003, approximately sixteen months before the dates of service at issue here. B.K.1 File, Exh. MAC-1. During the ten months at issue, the beneficiary’s physician signed certifications that she required, and should receive, skilled nursing services one to two times a month (for observation and assessment, and teaching medications) and personal care services five to seven times a week for the first eight months. See, e.g., B.K.1 File, Exh. 13; B.K.5 File, Exh. 13.
